title: [2.8.2.10-dev] Wrong Basal IOB in CALCULATOR Button (if Extended bolus is running ?)
symptom: When an extended bolus is running, the basal IOB shown in the Calculator button varies inconsistently between repeated openings, leading to very different proposed bolus calculations. The issue does not occur when no extended bolus is running.
cause: The thread identifies that there is an issue in IOB calculation for the contribution of a running Extended TBR, and the maintainer states that it was not one bug but two, fixed by a commit.
fix: The fix is a code commit referenced as https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8bac46830641a36934813d16b98d5413723baff3, which addresses the two bugs in the IOB calculation.
evidence_quote: it was not one bug but two :( fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8bac46830641a36934813d16b98d5413723baff3
